title: Gimbal object flying with a V-shaped fleet
summary: Marik von Rennenkampf tells of Gimbal object flying with a V-shaped fleet, about 2015 at Off the US East Coast (Roosevelt, 2014 to 2015), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: One other one other fact I just want to introduce is that possibly this was also in involved the formation of of other correct. That's the fleet.

related.note: The Gimbal crew audio saying 'a whole fleet of them' is about the same fleet accompanying the Gimbal object in 2015. The story only says the formation was possibly there, while this telling hears it stated by the crew on the tape.

plain: Gimbal is a 2015 Navy video, filmed off the US East Coast by fighter jets from the aircraft carrier Roosevelt, showing an object that seems to turn in the air. Marik von Rennenkampf, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, says that according to the Navy pilot Ryan Graves the object may have been flying with a whole fleet of other objects in a V shape, which would mean it was part of an organised group rather than a lone thing.
